DRY function: process and export annotated contrasts

Source: R/generatedContrastsDF.r
annotation_add_contrasts.Rd

DRY function: process and export annotated contrasts

Usage

annotation_add_contrasts(
  df,
  primary_col,
  secondary_col,
  prefix = "G_",
  dataset_id = "dataset",
  decreasing = FALSE,
  interactions = TRUE
)

Arguments

df

data.frame with annotation data

primary_col

character, name of the primary factor column

secondary_col

character, name of the secondary factor column

prefix

character, prefix for output naming (default "G_")

dataset_id

character, dataset identifier for output naming

decreasing

logical, if TRUE sort factor levels in decreasing order

interactions

logical, if TRUE include interaction contrasts

See also

Other contrasts: generate_contrasts(), generate_contrasts_for_factor(), interaction_contrasts(), level_specific_contrasts(), main_effect_contrasts()

Examples


annotation_add_contrasts(prolfqua::x5463yzwer453bbb, "factor_A", "factor_B", "primary")
